description: The L1 equivalence criterion for NONMEM .lst output: remove the incidental content two correct runs legitimately differ on - license/licensee, run date, run directory. A pure, content-addressed normalizer POTENTIAL: a definition, not an executor. It is realised by a normalizer-executor (e.g. spike-rcockpit/potentials/normalize.py), which - because it RUNS - must itself be qualified at L0 (byte-exact re-run) before it can be trusted to normalize outputs for qualifying other tools.
